purpose: Effective scope, causal propagation and proportionate new organizational capabilities.
use: Work whose consequences may spread to other components, domains or capabilities: determine effective scope and propagate proportionately.
semantic_conditions: Effective scope can exceed the literal request; new capabilities only when genuinely necessary.
mandatory_preconditions: Classified request, organizational model and dependency information.
postconditions_verification: All material consequences identified and dispositioned before completion.
